cohort: All qualified observed participants, irrespective of nationality or official role; batting and bowling separately.
interval_method: 80% split-conformal residual band from deterministic calibration IDs; held-out test IDs are disjoint. Future coverage is not guaranteed across changing seasons.
limitations: Only one historical transition is evaluated.
Returning players create survivorship and selection bias.
No independently verified age, injury, fitness or external-league form features.
Official roles are not inferred; production peer groups use observed innings.
The point model is pre-specified and untuned. Lower test MAE on this small split does not establish general usefulness.
Observed trend describes the two historical seasons, not a guaranteed future direction.
